answer: Governed comparison of this year with Last Year: net revenue decreased by 15.70% from $90,909,955.81 to $76,639,526.94 (absolute change $-14,270,428.87).
sql: SELECT SUM(orders.net_revenue) AS net_revenue, 'Latest period' AS comparison_period FROM orders WHERE NOT orders.status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') AND orders.order_date >= DATE('now', 'start of year') UNION ALL SELECT SUM(orders.net_revenue) AS net_revenue, 'Last Year' AS comparison_period FROM orders WHERE NOT orders.status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') AND orders.order_date >= DATE('now', 'start of year', '-1 year') AND orders.order_date < DATE('now', 'start of year') LIMIT 5000
